description: As Attorney General I will serve all New Yorkers, downstate and upstate, living in suburbs and cities and rural areas. I will fight for all New Yorkers, white or blue collar, poor or rich, young or old. I have the experience, energy, and values to make a difference for the People of New York, using the power of the Office of Attorney General.
